 Jacob Stein
 Head of Research, QuantumForge Technologies

 Hi Jacob,

 Emma Clarke

 --- Attachment ---
 QuantumForge Technologies  
 Patent Filing Status Summary  
 October 2025

 Prepared by: Emma Clarke, IP Coordinator  
 Last Updated: October 14, 2025

 Overview  
 This summary provides an overview of all active and pending patent filings managed by QuantumForge Technologies as of October 2025. A. ACTIVE PATENT FILINGS (Granted Patents)

 1. Quantum-Optimized Data Compression Algorithm  
    - Jurisdiction: United States (US Patent No. 11,589,310 ), Japan (JP 2023-144823)  
    - Filing Dates: US – August 20, 2022; JP – September 15, 2022  
    - Grant Dates: US – February 28, 2025; JP – Pending Examination  
    - Status: US Granted; JP Pending  
    - Description: Innovations in cryogenic-compatible hardware interconnects enabling improved scalability for quantum processor arrays.

 B. PENDING APPLICATIONS

 1. Adaptive Quantum Key Distribution System  
    - Jurisdictions: US (16/883,440), EU (EP22197654), China ( CN20251048213 )  
    - Filing Dates: US – November 18, 2023; EU – December 2, 2023; CN – December 19, 2023  
    - Current Statuses:
       • US – Non-Final Office Action issued Sept. 29, response due Nov. 30
       • EU – Awaiting examination assignment
       • CN – Formalities check completed
    - Description: A dynamic system for secure quantum key distribution adapting to network conditions in real-time.

 2. Quantum Machine Learning Optimization Framework  
    - Jurisdictions: US (17/401,533), South Korea ( KR1020240094821 )  
    - Description: Photonic control modules designed to reduce energy consumption in scalable qubit architectures.

The document includes application titles, jurisdictions, current statuses, relevant dates, and brief descriptions. Status updates are based on the latest communications from our legal team and patent offices.

 11,453,982 )  
    - Filing Date: March 3, 2022  
    - Grant Date: September 15, 2023  
    - Status: Granted  
    - Description: Proprietary algorithm for high-efficiency compression of quantum data streams with minimal loss. Utilized in QF’s core data transmission products.

 2. Multi-Layered Quantum Error Correction Protocol  
    - Jurisdiction: European Union (EP 21453298)  
    - Filing Date: May 12, 2022  
    - Grant Date: July 22, 2024  
    - Status: Granted  
    - Description: An advanced protocol for layered error correction in quantum communication systems, enhancing reliability across distributed networks.

 3. Scalable Cryogenic Interconnects for Quantum Processors  
    - Jurisdiction: United States (US Patent No. - Jurisdictions: US ( 17/235,921 ), Canada (CA3205829)  
    - Filing Dates: US – January 6, 2024; CA – January 10, 2024  
    - Current Statuses:
       • US – Initial review completed; awaiting examiner assignment
       • CA – Pre-examination search ongoing
    - Description: Methods and systems for optimizing machine learning algorithms using quantum computational resources.

 3. Low-Power Photonic Control Module for Qubit Arrays  
    - Filing Dates: US – April 15, 2024; KR – May 8, 2024  
    - Current Statuses:
       • US – Formalities check passed; awaiting publication
       • KR – Preliminary examination scheduled for Nov. ’25
    4. Secure Quantum Network Routing Protocols  
    - Filing Dates: EU – June 24, 2024; AU – July 3, 2024  
    - Current Statuses:
       • EU – Under substantive examination
       • AU – Request for examination filed
    - Description: Routing protocols enhancing security and efficiency of multi-node quantum networks.

 5. Integrated Quantum Sensor Array Platform  
    - Jurisdictions: US ( 17/589,342 ), India ( IN2024101256 )  
    - Filing Dates: US – August 12, 2024; IN – August 25, 2024  
    - Current Statuses:
       • US – Awaiting first office action
       • IN – Application acknowledged; awaiting technical review
    - Description: Modular sensor array platform for high-sensitivity quantum measurements in industrial applications.

 6. Quantum Random Number Generation Chipset v2.0  
    - Jurisdictions: US (17/635,489), EU (EP22310684), Singapore ( SG10202406548X )  
    - Filing Dates: US – September 29, 2024; EU/Singapore – October 7–10, 2024   
    - Current Statuses:
       • US – Application under formalities review
       • EU/Singapore – Applications received; initial processing underway
    - Description: Next-generation chipset architecture for true random number generation leveraging quantum phenomena.

 C. PROVISIONAL AND UPCOMING FILINGS

 1. Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing Architecture*   
     *Provisional Application Filed*
     - Jurisdiction: United States ( 63/531,922 )   
     - Filing Date: October 7, 2025   
     - Status: Provisional filed; non-provisional planned by October ’26   
     - Description: Hybrid design framework integrating classical compute nodes with quantum processors to maximize resource utilization.

 2. Real-Time Quantum Error Mitigation Suite*   
     *Drafting Stage*
     - Target Jurisdictions: US/EU/Japan   
     - Expected Filing Date(s): November–December ’25   
     - Status: In drafting with legal team   
     - Description: Software suite enabling real-time detection and mitigation of operational errors during quantum computations.

 D. SUMMARY OF STATUS UPDATES & KEY ACTION ITEMS

 - Office Actions & Responses:
      • Adaptive Quantum Key Distribution System (US): Non-final office action requires technical clarifications on claims #7–#12 regarding adaptive protocol switching.
      • Secure Quantum Network Routing Protocols (EU): Substantive examination focusing on inventive step over prior art references.
      • Integrated Quantum Sensor Array Platform (IN): Awaiting technical review committee feedback.
      • Scalable Cryogenic Interconnects for Quantum Processors (JP): Legal team coordinating response to request for additional experimental data.

 - Examinations Pending:
      • Quantum Machine Learning Optimization Framework (US/CA): Awaiting examiner assignment.
      • Low-Power Photonic Control Module for Qubit Arrays (KR): Preliminary examination set for November ’25.
      • Quantum Random Number Generation Chipset v2.0 (EU/SG): Initial processing underway; no issues flagged so far.

 - Upcoming Filings:
      • Real-Time Quantum Error Mitigation Suite is in advanced drafting stage with input from R&D and software teams.
      • Full application for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing Architecture is scheduled ahead of provisional expiry next year.

 E. PORTFOLIO METRICS

 As of October ’25:
 - Total granted patents worldwide: **6**
 - Active pending applications worldwide: **11**
 - Provisional applications on file or in drafting stage: **2**
 - Primary jurisdictions covered include United States, European Union, Japan, China, Canada, Australia, South Korea, India, Singapore.

 F. COLLABORATIONS AND THIRD-PARTY LICENSES

 - Collaboration with QubitWorks Inc. : Joint filing under review regarding “Multi-modal Qubit Synchronization Techniques” in the US and Germany.
 - License agreement update: “Quantum-Optimized Data Compression Algorithm” licensed to BlueNova Systems for use in telecommunications devices as of June ’25.
 - No outstanding disputes or oppositions reported in any jurisdiction as of this summary date.

 G. RISK AND CHALLENGE HIGHLIGHTS

 - Examiner scrutiny on inventive step and technical enablement remains high in the EU and Japan.
 - Increased competition observed in areas related to quantum error correction and photonic control modules—legal team monitoring third-party filings.
 - International harmonization efforts ongoing for parallel filings to reduce procedural delays between jurisdictions.

 H. NEXT STEPS & RECOMMENDATIONS

 1. Respond promptly to office actions—especially Adaptive QKD System in the US—to maintain prosecution timelines.
 2. Continue close coordination with legal counsel to prepare non-provisional application for Hybrid Architecture before provisional expiry.
 3. Monitor competitor activity and emerging technologies particularly around quantum sensor platforms and photonic chipsets.
 4. Consider development of a visual timeline summarizing prosecution stages across all filings for inclusion in the quarterly innovation report.
 5. Maintain regular updates between R&D leads and IP/legal teams to ensure invention disclosures are captured promptly.

 | Cryogenic Interconnects                   | US / JP                 | US11/589310 / JP144823   | Aug-20-22 / Sep-15-22    | Granted/Pending        |
 | Adaptive QKD System                      | US/EU/CN                | See above                | Nov-Dec’23               | Pending                |
 | ML Optimization Framework                 | US/CA                   | See above                | Jan-24                   | Pending                |
 | Photonic Control Module                   | US/KR                   | See above                | Apr-May’24               | Pending                |
 | Secure Network Routing                    | EU/AU                   | See above                | Jun-Jul’24               | Pending                |
 | Sensor Array Platform                     | US/IN                   | See above                | Aug’24                   | Pending                |
 | RNG Chipset v2                           | US/EU/SG                | See above                | Sep-Oct’24               | Pending                |

The leadership team wants an overview ahead of the quarterly innovation report.
Please find attached the current summary of all active and pending patent filings, including status updates from the legal team.
Let me know if you want a visual timeline for inclusion in the innovation report.
Prepared by: Emma Clarke, IP Coordinator
This summary provides an overview of all active and pending patent filings managed by QuantumForge Technologies as of October 2025.
The document includes application titles, jurisdictions, current statuses, relevant dates, and brief descriptions.
Status updates are based on the latest communications from our legal team and patent offices.
- Description: Proprietary algorithm for high-efficiency compression of quantum data streams with minimal loss.
Utilized in QF’s core data transmission products.
- Description: An advanced protocol for layered error correction in quantum communication systems, enhancing reliability across distributed networks.
Scalable Cryogenic Interconnects for Quantum Processors
- Filing Dates: US – August 20, 2022; JP – September 15, 2022
- Grant Dates: US – February 28, 2025; JP – Pending Examination
- Description: Innovations in cryogenic-compatible hardware interconnects enabling improved scalability for quantum processor arrays.
- Filing Dates: US – November 18, 2023; EU – December 2, 2023; CN – December 19, 2023
• US – Non-Final Office Action issued Sept.
- Description: A dynamic system for secure quantum key distribution adapting to network conditions in real-time.
- Filing Dates: US – January 6, 2024; CA – January 10, 2024
• US – Initial review completed; awaiting examiner assignment
- Description: Methods and systems for optimizing machine learning algorithms using quantum computational resources.
Low-Power Photonic Control Module for Qubit Arrays
- Filing Dates: US – April 15, 2024; KR – May 8, 2024
• US – Formalities check passed; awaiting publication
• KR – Preliminary examination scheduled for Nov.
- Description: Photonic control modules designed to reduce energy consumption in scalable qubit architectures.
- Filing Dates: EU – June 24, 2024; AU – July 3, 2024
- Description: Routing protocols enhancing security and efficiency of multi-node quantum networks.
- Filing Dates: US – August 12, 2024; IN – August 25, 2024
• IN – Application acknowledged; awaiting technical review
- Description: Modular sensor array platform for high-sensitivity quantum measurements in industrial applications.
Quantum Random Number Generation Chipset v2.0
- Filing Dates: US – September 29, 2024; EU/Singapore – October 7–10, 2024
• EU/Singapore – Applications received; initial processing underway
- Description: Next-generation chipset architecture for true random number generation leveraging quantum phenomena.
- Status: Provisional filed; non-provisional planned by October ’26
- Description: Hybrid design framework integrating classical compute nodes with quantum processors to maximize resource utilization.
- Status: In drafting with legal team
- Description: Software suite enabling real-time detection and mitigation of operational errors during quantum computations.
SUMMARY OF STATUS UPDATES & KEY ACTION ITEMS
• Adaptive Quantum Key Distribution System (US): Non-final office action requires technical clarifications on claims #7–#12 regarding adaptive protocol switching.
• Secure Quantum Network Routing Protocols (EU): Substantive examination focusing on inventive step over prior art references.
• Integrated Quantum Sensor Array Platform (IN): Awaiting technical review committee feedback.
• Scalable Cryogenic Interconnects for Quantum Processors (JP): Legal team coordinating response to request for additional experimental data.
• Quantum Machine Learning Optimization Framework (US/CA): Awaiting examiner assignment.
• Low-Power Photonic Control Module for Qubit Arrays (KR): Preliminary examination set for November ’25.
• Quantum Random Number Generation Chipset v2.0
(EU/SG): Initial processing underway; no issues flagged so far.
• Real-Time Quantum Error Mitigation Suite is in advanced drafting stage with input from R&D and software teams.
• Full application for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing Architecture is scheduled ahead of provisional expiry next year.
- Provisional applications on file or in drafting stage: **2**
- Primary jurisdictions covered include United States, European Union, Japan, China, Canada, Australia, South Korea, India, Singapore.
: Joint filing under review regarding “Multi-modal Qubit Synchronization Techniques” in the US and Germany.
- License agreement update: “Quantum-Optimized Data Compression Algorithm” licensed to BlueNova Systems for use in telecommunications devices as of June ’25.
- No outstanding disputes or oppositions reported in any jurisdiction as of this summary date.
- Examiner scrutiny on inventive step and technical enablement remains high in the EU and Japan.
- Increased competition observed in areas related to quantum error correction and photonic control modules—legal team monitoring third-party filings.
- International harmonization efforts ongoing for parallel filings to reduce procedural delays between jurisdictions.
Respond promptly to office actions—especially Adaptive QKD System in the US—to maintain prosecution timelines.
Continue close coordination with legal counsel to prepare non-provisional application for Hybrid Architecture before provisional expiry.
Monitor competitor activity and emerging technologies particularly around quantum sensor platforms and photonic chipsets.
Consider development of a visual timeline summarizing prosecution stages across all filings for inclusion in the quarterly innovation report.
Maintain regular updates between R&D leads and IP/legal teams to ensure invention disclosures are captured promptly.
